text: The Senior Corporate Management and Policy Consultant, City Manager's Office, and the Corporate Management and Policy Consultant, City Manager's Office, will give a presentation on the Development of Toronto Parking Authority's Relationship Framework. This presentation from the City Manager's Office is to familiarize the Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority with the purpose, content, and structure of a Relationship Framework, and to provide the process and status of the development of Toronto Parking Authority's Relationship Framework.
The Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority received this item for information.
